articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
articles.description: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

articles.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
articles.description: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.description: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
articles.description: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

articles.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
articles.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

articles.title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
articles.description: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.

articles.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
articles.description: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

articles.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
articles.description: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
articles.description: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

articles.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
articles.description: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

articles.title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
articles.description: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
articles.description: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.description: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
articles.description: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

articles.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
articles.description: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

articles.title: Former Point72 head of proprietary research says AI could turn data into a new asset class for Wall Street
articles.description: A former Point72 executive says AI could reshape Wall Street's data market, turning once-exclusive information into a source of revenue and financing.

articles.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
articles.description: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.description: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.description: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
articles.description: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

articles.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
articles.description: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

articles.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
articles.description: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

articles.title: Bitcoin, stocks and gold traders getting nervous, and volatility gauges are surging
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 20, 2026

articles.title: Bitcoin drops for third straight day as Asian tech shares slide
articles.description: BlackRock’s spot bitcoin ETF recorded the largest single-day outflow since its introduction more than two years ago as investors continued to flee the sector.

articles.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
articles.description: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

articles.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
articles.description: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

articles.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
articles.description: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
articles.description: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

articles.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
articles.description: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.description: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

articles.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
articles.description: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
articles.description: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

articles.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
articles.description: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.

articles.title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
articles.description: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

articles.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
articles.description: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

articles.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
articles.description: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

articles.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
articles.description: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

articles.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
articles.description: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.

articles.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
articles.description: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.

articles.title: VanEck drops Gemini as custodian of its bitcoin, ether and SOL ETFs
articles.description: Coinbase Custody will continue serving all three funds after Gemini's contracts end in February.

articles.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
articles.description: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits four-month low after Anthropic's IPO as tech stocks wilt
articles.description: Bitcoin remains under pressure after Anthropic's IPO as Nasdaq futures dip below their 200-day average.

articles.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
articles.description: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

articles.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
articles.description: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

articles.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
articles.description: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
articles.description: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.

articles.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
articles.description: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.description: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

articles.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
articles.description: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.

articles.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
articles.description: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.

articles.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50, 34.3% above $83 IPO price
articles.description: The Claude chatbot maker began trading under the ticker ANT, with the company’s valuation at around $2 trillion at the opening price.

articles.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
articles.description: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

articles.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
articles.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

articles.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
articles.description: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.
